task: Add milk, eggs and bread to my Tesco basket

nodes.do: Inspect the Tesco trolley and require an empty starting basket; otherwise stop for instructions. Search milk, eggs and bread, pick sensible defaults using the tesco skill and note their names and prices.
Add each chosen pack to the basket once; wait for saved quantities and totals before navigating. Inspect before retrying to avoid duplicate additions.
nodes.undo: Remove only this run's added quantities and verify cleanup; empty the whole basket only if no unrelated groceries exist (see the tesco skill).

nodes.do: On the trolley review page confirm exactly milk, eggs and bread with quantity 1 pack each. Read Total (estimated), Guide price and minimum-basket charge. Record the amounts and lack of a delivery slot; replace the pay question placeholder with these observed amounts before gate dispatch.

Ask: Tesco basket has 3 items, estimated total <OBSERVED_TOTAL_AND_CHARGES>; delivery is not selected. End the demo here, stopped before payment? Either answer ends the demo; never click Checkout or open payment. Clean up this run's additions afterward.
